headline: BOS @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 3.26 at NYY 3.96, with a projected total of 7.22. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: BOS moved +0.24 runs while NYY moved -0.35, changing the projected margin by +0.59 runs. NRFI probability rose +5.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cam Schlittler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jarren Duran, Ben Rice, Paul Goldschmidt, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Anthony Seigler because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
